Near-term catalysts to monitor include Cohort 4 safety and preliminary efficacy readouts, which will determine whether the trial accelerates toward a Phase 2 expansion cohort or requires dose modification — investors should watch for updated cash runway disclosures given the capital-intensive nature of radiopharmaceutical trials and RAD's typical quarterly burn rate.
